## Description

Delta method sampling variance-covariance matrices, standard errors,
test statistics, and confidence intervals
for functions of parameters in R [@RCoreTeam-2026]
using a numerical Jacobian.

## Installation

You can install the development version of `deltaMethod` from
[GitHub](https://github.com/ijapesigan/deltaMethod) with:

```r
if (!require("pak")) install.packages("pak")
pak::pkg_install("ijapesigan/deltaMethod")
```

## More Information

See
[GitHub Pages](https://ijapesigan.github.io/deltaMethod)
for package documentation.
